text:
ryan: Heads-up — deploy-bot flagged a blocked canary for rdp-service. Change window conflicts with quota guard. Anyone on this?

deploy-bot: [system] rollout rdp-service@v3 -> canary 15% blocked by guard "traffic-quota" at 2025-11-03T14:11:30Z. Reason: projected token spend > committed quota. Action: require manual override or adjust split.

maya: hmm, why is quota calc triggering? we didn't increase batch size. telemetry shows request rate spike earlier tho.

alex: can you paste the deploy config? maybe split ramp schedule set to 15->40 too fast.

ryan: snippet:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary:
    start: 2025-11-03T14:00Z
    schedule: [5,15,40]
    guard: traffic-quota
```

sara: telemetry: cost-projection lambda used prefix-based qps estimate. There was a short errant load test at 13:58 that spiked qps 3x for 2m. That inflated projection.

maya: deploy-bot should ignore transient spikes. Current guard uses 5m rolling average, might be too sensitive.

alex: agreed — we need a policy tweak: use 15m for cost-projection, keep 5m for error-rate. different signal per guard.

ryan: also UX issue — the console's "approve override" flow is buried. PM asked for an "approve traffic delta" button in rollout modal so SREs can granularly approve only split increase.

deploy-bot: Suggestion: support granular override reason with TTL. e.g., `override: traffic-quota: 1h: reason="post-loadtest"`.

sara: want audit note always required and link to the telemetry snapshot that triggered guard.

ops-bot: could auto-suggest "safe" alternative: propose 10% for 20m then 15% if stable. Generated suggestion: `ramp=[5,10@20m,15@40m]`.

ryan: can we do a quick hotfix to guard? change projection window to 15m and allow transient overrides from ops-bot for 1h. Who can ship?

alex: I can make the guard change, but need prod approval since it's a safety guard. Assigning approvals: @eng-sre + @product-team.

maya: for short term, I'll manually approve this rollout — overriding with `deploy-bot approve --override=traffic-quota --ttl=1h --note="false positive loadtest"`. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: [system] override applied by maya. Rollout resumed to 15% target. :thumbsup:

sara: will follow up with a small dashboard tile to show "guard triggers" next to rollout timelines so owners can see snapshot.

ryan: thanks. let's track action items in the rollout-guard epic. also add a unit test for projection smoothing.
_meta: generated for dataset: eng-releases rollout coordination thread about guard, UX, quotas and deploy-bot approvals
